prompts.task: Implement JWT auth guard with refresh token rotation
prompts.template:
Implement a complete JWT auth system in NestJS with:
- JwtAuthGuard (validates access tokens)
- RefreshTokenGuard (validates refresh tokens)
- AuthService (login, refresh, logout)
- Token rotation on refresh

Available skills: {skills}
constraints: Store refresh tokens hashed in DB
Invalidate old refresh tokens on rotation
Return proper JWT payload with roles
